    Profile

    Nimul is the leader of Sephira Village, located in the Gula Belt region. Seeing the role his sister was born into, he questioned the structure of a world that sacrificed some for the prosperity of others and sought to change it. It is for that purpose that he created a new power and became the original founder of alchemy. Though he is a fearsome and powerful figure, he also has a protective side when it comes to his dear sister.

    Origin: Gula Belt Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 183cm
    Weight: 72kg
    Birthday: Apr 7
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: The Unknown
    Hobbies: Daydreaming
    Illust: RINZO（G-ROW）
    CV: 小林千晃
